title: Ipsos AI Monitor 2026
discussion_signal: Ipsos presents public AI attitudes as a dual bargain: people report time savings and expect major change while simultaneously expressing nervousness, concern about environmental and labour effects, and lower trust when commercial incentives shape answers.
linked_research_question: How are people negotiating AI adoption when practical usefulness, future expectations, labour concerns, environmental costs, and commercial trust move in opposite directions?
limits: The post summarizes Ipsos survey results rather than exposing the full instrument or microdata
Global averages can conceal country and demographic differences
The discussion reports attitudes and does not establish later behaviour or causal effects
